items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I have Thaddeus Richard who used to be the saxophone player with Paul McCartney and Wings

ctx.x: Have you ever led your own group for any length of time?

Yeah. I mean I still have a band that I tour with now. I just call it the Wendell Brunious New Orleans All-Stars. We’ve toured all through Germany. I had a beautiful two weeks in Korea that I brought my band on and we did a CD from that, and it was really, really great, I mean really great. And Freddy Longo tours with me and he’s a really great trombone player. I had Charlie Gabriel, who is from New Orleans but he lives in Detroit now, he left New Orleans with the Fats Navarro kids band, like way back in ’47 or…
